_readme: The one source for every event on the site: the homepage hero (featured: true), the homepage 'Upcoming at St. Matthias' cards (everything else), and the /events/ page.
Only public events confirmed on the parish calendar or by the parish office belong here. No bulletins, internal meetings, or special-collection reminders.
Dated events use 'sessions' (ISO 8601 with the Pacific offset: -08:00 in winter, -07:00 in summer). An event disappears from the site after its last session ends.
Recurring events use 'recurrence' and 'time' instead of 'sessions'.
Set 'status' to 'development' only for placeholder events while designing; development events are never published (the build refuses them).

events.title: Masses of Remembrance
events.description: Bring a photo of someone you love for the ofrenda at the back of the church. At each Mass we read aloud the names of those who died this past year, light a candle for each, and send families home with a daffodil bulb to plant.
events.source: Parish calendar (public Google Calendar feed), checked 2026-11-04; ritual details from Deacon Rich Foley, email 2026-11-05

events.title: Caroling, Cookies & Cocoa
events.description: Dress warmly and bring a bell. Our young adults lead the carols, then everyone warms up with cookies and cocoa. Song sheets provided, because nobody knows the second verse. Families from the preschool are joining us too.
events.source: Parish calendar (date); start time, place, and details from Melanie Dresbach and Deacon Rich Foley, emails 2026-10-22 and 2026-11-04

events.title: Christmas Eve Masses
events.description: Welcome the birth of Jesus Christ at an afternoon or evening Mass. Visiting family and friends are welcome too.
events.source: Parish calendar (public Google Calendar feed), checked 2026-11-04

events.title: St. Vincent de Paul Winter Drive
events.location: Drop-off in Fr. Lacey Hall at weekend Masses
events.description: Socks and coats top the list. Bring men’s and women’s winter wear to Mass either weekend: new thick socks and thermals, or gently used coats, sweaters, hats, scarves, mittens, blankets, and sleeping bags. St. Vincent de Paul gets it all to day laborers and unhoused neighbors. No children’s items, please.
events.source: St. Vincent de Paul flyer (Joanne Thompson) and emails from Deacon Rich Foley and Bob Thompson, 2026-10-20 to 2026-11-05

events.title: Little Turkeys Dine Out Night
events.description: Skip the dishes Tuesday night. Dinner at McDonald’s on Chestnut Street becomes a fundraiser for St. Matthias Preschool, and the proceeds buy new trikes and bikes for the playground.
events.source: Preschool fundraiser flyer from Rosemary Juarez, email 2026-11-04

events.title: Welcome Weekend
events.recurrence: Second full weekend of each month
events.location: St. Matthias Church and Fr. Lacey Hall
events.description: New to St. Matthias? Receive a special blessing at Mass, then stay: appetizers and a movie about a saint after Saturday Mass, donuts and coffee in Fr. Lacey Hall after Sunday Mass.

events.title: Rosary for Peace
